description.en: Returns the current playback position of the track on the BGM channel, as a value the BGM open call accepts back: CMND_SND_OPEN_BGM(name, 0, pos) starts the track from there. The ev_main helpers SaveBgmHistory and OpenBgmHistory(true) use the pair to resume a track. The unit was not traced.

Playback position of the current BGM (-1 or 0 when there is none).
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Saving and resuming the music (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
